description: This file defines the class LogFileIterator in the namespace Aws\CloudTrail, which provides functionality to iterate over AWS CloudTrail log files stored in S3. It includes methods for constructing iterators based on trail options, filtering by date and pattern, and normalizing date inputs.

classes.name: LogFileIterator
classes.description: Iterator class to iterate over CloudTrail log files stored in S3, with filtering options for date range, trail name, account ID, and region.

methods.name: forTrail
methods.description: Factory method to create a LogFileIterator for a specific trail, retrieving bucket info from AWS CloudTrail.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for LogFileIterator that initializes it with S3 client, bucket name, and options for filtering logs.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Overrides parent's current method to return an array with bucket and key of the current log file.

methods.name: buildListObjectsIterator
methods.description: Builds an iterator that lists S3 objects filtered by prefix, date, and pattern based on provided options.

methods.name: normalizeDateValue
methods.description: Converts various date input formats into a unix timestamp.

methods.name: determineDateForPrefix
methods.description: Generates a date string pattern for the S3 key prefix based on start and end dates.

methods.name: applyRegexFilter
methods.description: Applies regex filtering to S3 objects based on key pattern and wildcards.

methods.name: applyDateFilter
methods.description: Filters S3 objects based on date embedded in their keys, within a specified date range.
